mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenues, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenue expectations and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that may trigger a future rate hike, increasing equity discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 16400.0 in t-6mo and UNRATE > 5.0 in t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% and a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k signals a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which may prompt monetary tightening and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightness with inflation risk
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates a contraction in manufacturing and labor demand, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100.0 in t-1mo and UNRATE > 5.0 in t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 2-year window.
